{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Filter to only customers who converted (converted == 1)
df_converted = df_filtered[df_filtered['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = df_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result to ensure it's captured in output
print(mean_age_converted)"}
